newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Cultus says Skull Creek sales approved.
newsitem.headline: Cultus says Skull Creek sales approved.

text.p: Cultus Petroleum NL said on Thursday the Victorian government has approved the sale of gas from the Skull Creek gas field to gas retailer Kinetik Energy.
Delivery of gas could begin as soon as the sales agreement was executed by the state-owned Gascor, it said.
This agreement would conclude the final step in the process of bringing the field to market, Cultus said.
Kinetic Energy is one of six new gas companies being spun out of Gascor to maximise competition in the state's retail and distribution industries, but would not by fully corporatised until November.
A Cultus spokesman said the well was ready to begin production and the company hoped to start gas deliveries by the end of the month.
Cultus was contracted to deliver a total of five petajoules of gas from the field, he said.
